sop_thesis: **The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company (GT)** operates in Consumer Discretionary (Automotive Aftermarket) with an established market capitalization of $1.34B. The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Brand Equity, Omnichannel Logistics Scale & Customer Loyalty. Long-term valuation metrics model an intrinsic DCF fair value of $5.22 (18.1% margin of safety). Systematic tranche entry is recommended at $4.33 (Tranche 1), $4.07 (Tranche 2), and $3.76 (Tranche 3).
